alt: Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max with the Ruiying Z10 camera module screwed onto its back, the large zoom lens barrel extending far beyond the phone's slim profile
story: Huawei launched the Ruiying Z10 on October 1, 2026 — a $895, 346g camera module with a 1-inch sensor and 10x optical zoom that screws onto the Mate 90 Pro Max via a DSLR-style bayonet mount. The entire premise of smartphone photography was eliminating the need to carry a separate camera; the Z10 reverses that by bolting a lens bigger than many mirrorless bodies onto a phone.
why_funny: The phone camera was supposed to replace your camera bag; Huawei's answer to 'how do we improve phone cameras?' is to turn your phone into a camera bag.
